basic_info.description: Beautiful, updated Edwardian condo in highly desirable central Richmond District location. Versatile floorplan consisting of 3br/1.5ba plus huge separate formal dining room, flexspace niche in hallway, large walk-in pantry, exclusive use laundry room. Tandem one-car parking in garage w/additional spacious separate storage area in garage. (NO outdoor space). Hardwood floors throughout w/gorgeous detail throughout. Dramatic, curved ceilings with gorgeous trim molding. Grandiose arched windows, decorative fireplace and built-in bookshelf in living room. Gourmet kitchen features stainless steel appliances, slab counters, and extensive cabinetry. Full bath features shower/tub combo with custom tile/glass & two sink vanity; Additional powder room and half bath. Convenient in-unit washer/dryer in separate dedicated laundry room. Only two blocks to Golden Gate Park and walking distance to numerous cafes, shops, & restaurants on Balboa, Geary, & Clement St. (only two blocks to popular Coffee Movement, Han Il Kwan restaurant, and more!) Easy walking distance to multiple public transit lines on Fulton Ave., Balboa Ave., & Geary Blvd.
